newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in thin trade on Friday and food concern Podravka took the spotlight as leading gainer and the most active stock.
* Five of 12 active issues fell, three rose and four were unchanged.
* Volume doubled 6.283 shares on a slightly lower turnover of 2.5 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer and the most actively traded issue was food company Podravka which rose 12 kuna to 320 on a high volume of 3,546 shares.
* Leading decliner was hotelier Suncani Hvar, losing four kuna to 66 on volume of 653 units.
